text:
Riley P.: @Michelle — quick confidential ask. My migraines have gotten a lot worse with the open office noise and bright lighting. Can we talk about a temporary schedule adjustment and a quieter workspace accommodation? I'm worried about being on-call this week.

Michelle (EM): Thanks for telling me, Riley. Can we do a 15 min sync today? Also noting I've seen a couple missed deadlines last month — want to understand how this is impacting your work and support you.

Riley P.: Yep, I can do 15. For context, the sensory stuff directly affects my concentration and causes post-migraine recovery that disrupts afternoon work. I don't want the performance notes to be the only response; I'd prefer formal accommodation so it's documented and we can get interim support. Please keep this private.

Michelle (EM): Understood and will keep it private. @Sam - People Ops, can you advise next steps and what interim options we can put in place immediately?

Sam - People Ops: Hi @Riley — sorry you're dealing with this. Please submit the confidential accommodation form (https://intranet/redwood/accom-form) when you can; medical documentation is optional but helpful. We'll start the interactive process on receipt. Interim reasonable adjustments we can implement right away: noise-cancelling headphones, reserved quiet desk, temporary adjusted start/end times up to 2 hours, and on-call shift swaps for up to 2 weeks. We aim to respond within 3 business days after the form is submitted.

Riley P.: Thanks Sam. For now, quiet desk + shifting my start 1.5 hours earlier would help, and I'd like someone to swap my on-call for the next two rotations if possible.

Michelle (EM): I can swap on-call with Jamal for the next two rotations. I'll also request the quiet desk with Facilities now.

Sam - People Ops: Noted. @Michelle please post a short confirmation here once you've made the swap so it's in the thread. Riley — we'll keep all accommodation records private and share only with people who need to implement them. Expect an update by 3 business days (by 2305135600).

hr-bot: Accommodation form submitted — case A-2023-119 logged and assigned to Jamal (People Ops).

Jamal (People Ops): Hi everyone, taking the case. I'll DM Riley to confirm dates and any supporting docs, and I'll coordinate with Facilities and the on-call scheduler. We'll limit visibility to the manager, People Ops, and Facilities for execution.

Riley P.: Appreciate it. One more thing — can I request async stand-ins for recurring meetings that overlap with my new hours so I don't have to join live?

Michelle (EM): Absolutely. I'll update invites to allow async updates and make sure recordings are available.

Sam - People Ops: Interim plan summary: quiet desk reserved (pending Facilities confirmation), schedule shift approved for 2 weeks, on-call swapped for next two rotations, records marked confidential. We'll follow up after the formal review.

Riley P.: Thank you everyone :heart: Much relief to have a plan.
